name: Coupa Mobile
description:
Use Coupa’s Business Spend Management mobile app for rapid access, personalized for you:

HOME PAGE
• See an overview of your activity and navigate easily
• Take quick actions or jump directly to recent documents
• View announcements from your company

APPROVE
• Get push notifications when a request needs your attention
• Approve, reject, or hold documents to keep your business moving

EXPENSE
• Create and submit expense reports on the go
• Capture expenses easily with receipt photos and quick OCR, or manual entry

SHOP
• See personalized catalog and Open Buy recommendations
• Write a Request for off-catalog items

RECEIVE
• Mark PO lines as received so suppliers can get paid
• Use the camera to attach pictures as proof of receipt

VIRTUAL CARDS
• View active virtual cards for purchase orders or pre-approved expenses
• See card balances and upload receipts for individual transactions
• View your expired cards and transactions

Coupa mobile is free for Coupa users. Use the same URL and login as in a web browser. App and feature availability depend on your company settings.
